conventions.ids: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (no AUTOINCREMENT — portable; SQLite auto-assigns rowids, MySQL needs a vendor-specific migration to add AUTO_INCREMENT later)
conventions.timestamps: TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, treated as UTC
conventions.booleans: BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (SQLite stores as INTEGER, MySQL as TINYINT)
conventions.foreign_keys: explicit FOREIGN KEY (...) REFERENCES ...; no ON DELETE clauses in v1
conventions.sql_dialect: DB-agnostic — no vendor-specific syntax in committed migrations

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Application users with web-panel access. One row per MC player granted access.

columns.name: username
columns.comment: MC username at registration time; not unique (MC name swaps between accounts are possible)

columns.name: password_hash
columns.comment: Argon2id; null until the registration flow completes

columns.name: is_admin
columns.comment: v1: everyone with access is admin; column reserved for future role hierarchy

tables.name: agents
tables.purpose: Registered Paper/Velocity instances. One row per server_id; written on first Hello.

columns.name: server_id
columns.comment: Stable identifier supplied by the agent in Hello

columns.name: agent_type
columns.comment: Enum-by-convention: 'paper' | 'velocity' (not enforced by CHECK to stay DB-agnostic)

columns.name: last_seen_at
columns.comment: Updated on each heartbeat; null until the first Hello

tables.name: registration_tokens
tables.purpose: One-time URLs minted by /ap register. Consumed when the user sets a password.

columns.name: token
columns.comment: Opaque random string; the URL slug

columns.name: consumed_at
columns.comment: Non-null once the registration completes; reject reuse

tables.name: audit_log
tables.purpose: Append-only record of mutations. One row per mutating action.

columns.name: payload_json
columns.comment: JSON-encoded extra context; schema is per-action
